title: GTA6 Infamous Leaker CyberLeek Returns With 25-Minute NSFW Footage
description: The infamous GTA 6 leaker 'CyberLeek' is back with a 25-minute video featuring dev menus, dirt-biking, and nude scenes of Jason and Lucia.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Leaker Returns: A 25-Minute Deep Dive Into New Footage

It appears that the infamous GTA 6 leaker known as 'CyberLeek' is back in the spotlight. According to recent reports from gaming media outlet Eurogamer, the leaker has published a massive 25-minute video showcasing fresh footage from Rockstar Games' highly anticipated upcoming title.

### Inside the 25-Minute Leak

The newly surfaced video offers a raw look at the game's development state. Most notably, the footage includes a functioning development menu (dev menu), which strongly suggests the source has ties to internal builds or early testing phases.

In addition to the developer tools, the video features a variety of gameplay elements and highly explicit content. Eurogamer has confirmed seeing scenes that include full-frontal nudity, featuring a fully naked Jason and a topless Lucia. The footage also highlights dynamic open-world activities, such as dirt-biking across the landscape, demonstrating the game's evolving mechanics and physics systems.

### Authenticity and the 'CyberLeek' Trademark

As has become traditional with high-profile leaks surrounding the franchise, the video features 'CyberLeek's' distinctive emblem overlaid directly onto the footage. While Rockstar Games has not issued an official statement regarding this specific breach, Eurogamer's review indicates that the video appears to be legitimate.

### Editor's Take

This latest 25-minute leak is a stark reminder of the ongoing security challenges facing major game developers. While the temptation to peek behind the curtain is high, we remind the community to approach unauthorized leaks with caution and look forward to Rockstar's official reveals.
